subject.title: feat(session): add chat-channel session switching with LRU history retention

question: Should OpenClaw accept this `/sessions` plus `session.historyLimit` design, prefer the overlapping `/resume` direction, or keep the tracker open until a different chat-session command and restore-boundary contract is chosen?
rationale: The remaining blockers include a user-facing command contract, a new config/persisted-state surface, and security-sensitive session restore semantics that cannot be safely resolved by cleanup automation alone.

options.title: Keep the tracker canonical and require repair
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/86829 as the canonical decision point, then land only a rebased PR that fixes restore boundaries and includes real chat proof.

options.title: Sponsor this command shape
options.body: Proceed with this `/sessions` design only after the contributor repairs the P1 findings, resolves conflicts, and supplies redacted live chat proof.

options.title: Prefer the `/resume` alternative
options.body: Use the overlapping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/82684 direction instead if maintainers want a narrower command contract, after its own blockers are fixed.

recommendation.title: Keep the tracker canonical and require repair
recommendation.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/86829 as the canonical decision point, then land only a rebased PR that fixes restore boundaries and includes real chat proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main blame and session-state cleanup history make this the strongest available owner for command-shape and session-boundary direction.
